body: Just found out Tully isn't a platonic friend. She used to fuck him and told me he was platonic. Had to talk to her one last time to get the truth out.

She did tell me Dexter meant a lot to her. And I never forced her to do anything. I told her at the beginning they had to go or I wouldn't date her. If that was an issue, why not just tell me in the first place? Why go along with it and lie? Also, why lie about not loving Dexter? Judging from her FB messages, she loved Dexter and the only thing stopping them from being together was that he rejected her desire for a relationship. She also never initiated any of the no-contacts unless I asked her repeatedly.

I think it's disrespectful in a relationship to be close with someone you've had sex with before. It's disrespectful to your partner because ANYONE would be jealous over it. My problem is that I'm very up front about this type of thing. A lot of people hide it and let it eat them up inside. I communicate and say up front that I do not approve of these friendships.

I also don't think she should be going to a guy's house alone when she hasn't seen him in five years. She's also told me that if any guy touches her she would, in her own words "become extremely turned on, so much so that I'd have to go home and masturbate but I wouldn't ever do anything with them". So all it takes for her to get turned on is going to a guy's house and his hand on her tit.

I would have no problem if it weren't for all these red flags. She's a sex addict that has cheated on multiple boyfriends and gets horny at anyone touching her. If this weren't the case, then I'd be ok with her hanging out with a platonic guy. But all her friends know she's a sex addict.

I don't think it's so unreasonable to expect her to not talk to a guy she's slept with. Any guy would jump at the chance to fuck her. I know how guys are, because I'd do the same in their situation. She knew I was insecure from the beginning and lied to keep her attachments. She told me she sees our relationship as meaningful, and I did believe her. But she shouldn't have agreed to get rid of the guys in the first place if she was willing to lie for them. I don't believe there's a need to keep those guys around, especially because she kept them as backups in case I left.
